_v2_roadmap_note: Replace the SHA256 fingerprint when wiring Android App Links. Get the value with: keytool -list -v -keystore /root/.hermes/secrets/familybridge_keystore/familybridge-upload.keystore (password in keystore_password.txt). Use the SHA256 line, then for production builds also include the Play App Signing certificate fingerprint from Play Console → Setup → App integrity. The file must be served as application/json at https://familybridgeapp.com/.well-known/assetlinks.json with HTTP 200. See docs/v2-roadmap.md item 2.2.
